contracts.source: Synopsys press release: OpenAI and Synopsys Announce GPT-Synopsys: Frontier (09-30-2026)
contracts.signal: Synopsys and OpenAI signed an expansive, multi-year agreement to collaborate as preferred partners to jointly develop GPT-Synopsys, a specialized model optimized to use Synopsys EDA tools to perform semiconductor design workflows. OpenAI will license Synopsys' EDA tools for development of the model; the agreement includes a revenue sharing arrangement and joint R&D and go-to-market. GPT-Synopsys will run on OpenAI-hosted infrastructure, interoperate with customer agent harness systems and integrate with Synopsys.ai and the Synopsys Autopilot agentic AI platform; the joint service will bundle compute, model and licenses. Early technology engagements are underway with leading semiconductor customers (not named); no availability date stated.
contracts.type: multi-year EDA licence + co-development partnership with revenue sharing
